## About
Carsport Automotive is a car repair and maintenance shop on S Mason Rd in Katy. Our technicians work on foreign and domestic cars, using modern diagnostic equipment to find the problem before we fix it.
A lot of our customers come to us because a neighbor sent them, and many have stayed for years. Reviewers tell us they appreciate straight answers, fair prices and a shop that only suggests the work your car really needs.
We hold a 4.7 rating from 242 Google reviews, and we would be glad to earn your trust too.

## Services
- Brake service: Grinding, a spongy pedal or a shaking steering wheel when you stop are all reasons to have your brakes checked. We handle rotors and drums, pads and shoes, calipers, brake lines, fluid and parking brake adjustment.
- Electrical service: We diagnose and repair charging and starting problems, including alternators, starters and ignition switches, plus lights, wiring, fuses, the ECM and power windows and locks.
- Transmission service: Automatic transmission service, minor automatic transmission repair, manual transmission repairs and clutch replacement.
- New battery: If your car won't start, we can check whether the battery is the problem and put in a new one, often while you wait.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. Our technicians work on both foreign and domestic cars.

Q: Should I make an appointment?
A: We are usually busy, so it helps to plan ahead and call us before you come in.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.
